speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure secondary to Dilated Cardiomyopathy.

The history of a 3-year-old with rapid breathing, leg swelling, and loss of appetite, combined with findings of hepatomegaly and pitting edema, strongly points to fluid overload due to heart failure. Since there are no signs of infection like fever or cough, I will proceed with this diagnosis.
